### Summary

Group activation changes could omit owner authorization. In affected versions, an authorized non-owner channel sender could change whether a group required mention-based activation.

This advisory is scoped to persistent `/activation` policy changes. It does not make session presence or conversation ownership a security boundary; the failed control is the documented owner requirement for changing channel trigger policy.

### Impact

A non-owner sender could make the agent respond more broadly in a group or suppress expected activation behavior. This could expose responses to additional group traffic or reduce availability until an owner restored the intended setting.

### Patched Versions

The first stable patched version is `2026.7.1`.

### Mitigations

upgrade to `openclaw@2026.7.1` or later. Before upgrading, disable activation-setting commands in shared channels and verify group activation configuration after untrusted command activity.
summary: Group activation changes could omit owner authorization
